youtube_description:
Explore the serene beauty of a campground located near Starved Rock State Park in this relaxing video tour. Join us as we wander through the RV section, playground, and scenic riverfront. Discover camping amenities like a campgrounds shop with a firewood vending machine, perfect for a cozy night under the stars. Whether you're an avid camper or simply seeking a peaceful retreat, this video offers a glimpse into the tranquil surroundings of nature. Subscribe for more outdoor adventures and campground explorations!

We are strolling around the campgrounds at Starved Rock State Park. Before you enter these campgrounds there is a firewood dispensing vending machine. The Starved Rock campgrounds are open year-round. Starved Rock also has cabins available to sleep in.
